guide.title: Journey map
guide.subtitle: Give posts a place and show readers the whole journey.
guide.step1: Open a post in the editor. The Places section is under the excerpt. A new post needs saving once before it can have places.
guide.step2: Search for the place by name, or click the map to drop a pin. Use Add a place when the post covers a trip, and the arrows to set their order.
guide.step3: Choose Exact spot, or Approximate area to round the place to about 1 km.
guide.step4: Leave the stop number empty to order stops by publish date, or give numbers to set the order yourself.
guide.step5: Press Save places. The places save on their own, without saving the post.
guide.readers1: A short map after the post showing its part of the journey, with the distance from the stop before. A Next stop link appears when the journey order differs from the posting order.
guide.readers2: A Journey link in the blog menu that opens every stop on one map.
guide.readersReplay: The Journey page draws the route stop by stop as readers scroll through it.
guide.readers3: Only published, public posts appear. Drafts, scheduled and private posts stay hidden until they go public.
guide.privacy: Use Approximate area for places that should stay private, like your home. The exact point is then never stored.
guide.noStops: No post has a place yet.
